/**
 * @file @cms/tokens/base.js
 * @description CMS-private BEM block names — the shared fragments every
 * CMS token group composes from so class spellings stay consistent.
 * CMS-only: never imported by the public site bundle.
 */

/**
 * CMS-private BEM block names See the module header for usage.
 */
export const _B_CMS = 'cms'
/**
 * BEM block fragment "b admin" — composed by the token groups below into full class names.
 */
export const _B_ADMIN = 'admin'
/**
 * BEM block fragment `…` — declared once here; every domain class token composes from this
 * fragment (zero-hardcoding rule 9).
 */
export const _B_CMS_CARD = `${_B_CMS}-card`
